title: OTR audio cache sidecar
description: Metadata sidecar persisted beside each cached audio buffer (plan G0). Mirrors nodes/_otr_audio_cache.AudioCacheRecord field-for-field; the cache key is cache_key == ResolvedVoiceRequest.cache_key (I-6). Only cache_key is required so a partially-populated record still round-trips; the release gate enforces allowed_for_release + a present commercial_clean boolean (I-8). v2 (cloud-audio-cache chunk 2, 2026-08-08) adds actual_sample_rate and provider_model_id for drift forensics against Gemini TTS.

cache_key.description: sha256 over the ResolvedVoiceRequest IN_KEY fields (I-6).

request_schema_version.description: ResolvedVoiceRequest schema version; a record whose version != the build target is re-rendered (slim migration).

actual_sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the STORED audio bytes; may differ from the request's sample_rate (identity) when the provider returned a different rate. Null when unknown.

provider_model_id.description: Readable id of the actual model that produced the bytes (e.g. Gemini variant). For drift forensics; the OPAQUE identity is provider_model_id in ResolvedVoiceRequest IN_KEY.

commercial_clean.description: I-8; a null here is fail-closed at the release gate.

allowed_for_release.description: G0: the release manifest refuses any record not allowed_for_release.
